import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def blank(h,w): return [[6]*w for _ in range(h)]
def ring(g,r0,r1,c0,c1,color):
    for c in range(c0,c1+1): g[r0][c]=g[r1][c]=color
    for r in range(r0,r1+1): g[r][c0]=g[r][c1]=color
# Reconstruct the single demonstration's five outlined rectangles from its listed cells.
demo=blank(24,23)
for rect,color in [((0,7,2,9),5),((2,9,13,20),8),((9,11,4,6),3),((17,20,6,8),5),((17,20,18,21),1)]: ring(demo,*rect,color)
expected=[row[:] for row in demo]
for r0,r1,c0,c1,color in [(0,7,2,9,2),(2,9,13,20,2),(9,11,4,6,7),(17,20,6,8,7),(17,20,18,21,2)]:
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1): expected[r][c]=color
actual=mod.transform(demo)
print('demo match:', actual==expected)
test=blank(10,26); ring(test,5,7,22,24,8)
answer=mod.transform(test)
print('test output:')
for row in answer: print(row)
